name: clip-content-rewards
description: Monorepo studio lokal AI Auto-Editor, Viral Scorer & Upload Playbook untuk Content Rewards (Nuxt 3 + Express TS + SQLite + Local FFmpeg)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @clip/api" "npm run dev -w @clip/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clip/shared && npm run build -w @clip/api && npm run build -w @clip/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @clip/shared && npm run typecheck -w @clip/api && npm run typecheck -w @clip/web
